dispatch: Session 305 finds the vault settled: /proof stands fully live on production, its ledger, hash-verifier, and constellation sealed together with a sitewide badge to prove it. Session 304's retrospective closed 12 of 13 hardening items and pushed the public chain to depth 28, narrowing release-proof blockers from nine to four. In the forge, Studio Pulse now hydrates live from the public intelligence feed while 6 projects sit sparked and 7 sealed.
